title: Rishabh Pant — fastest batter to 100 Test sixes
summary: Reached 100 sixes in **4,918 balls faced** — fastest ever (previous fastest: Adam Gilchrist, 6,578 balls); 4th batter overall to reach 100 Test sixes...

items: Reached 100 sixes in **4,918 balls faced** — fastest ever (previous fastest: Adam Gilchrist, 6,578 balls); 4th batter overall to reach 100 Test sixes
